module: Flowgraph node "Detect Acceleration At Start" (category repeat_instant, timer icon). Used to start a mission when the player moves rather than after a countdown. Inputs: flow, reset (pulse that resets the initial position), vehId (tracked vehicle, otherwise player vehicle 0). Output: success (flow) true when the vehicle has moved more than 0.1 m away from its initial position. As long as the vehicle has not moved, sends the UI message 'ScenarioRealtimeDisplay' (missions.general.moveToStart, context accelerateToBegin); it is cleared on the first movement.
notes: Option data.useScenarioRealtimeDisplay (true by default): enables the display of the start message.
The position is read from map.objects[vehId].pos; if the vehicle is not listed there, the node does nothing.

init.desc: Initializes initialPos to nil, msgSent to true and data.useScenarioRealtimeDisplay to true.

_executionStarted.desc: Resets the initial position and msgSent when the graph starts.

work.desc: Every frame: handles reset, stores the vehicle's initial position, shows/clears the start message and sets success to true if the vehicle has moved more than 0.1 m.
